name: DescribeAlerts

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 事件关联告警ID
parameters.name: alert_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The threat levels. This parameter is a JSON array. Valid values:

- `serious`: high

- `suspicious`: medium

- `remind`: low
parameters.help_zh:
威胁等级，格式为json数组。取值：
- serious：高危
- suspicious：中危
- remind：低危
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The source of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 事件关联告警来源产品
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the threat is defended. Valid values:

- `0`: detected

- `1`: blocked
parameters.help_zh:
是否已防御。取值：

- 0：检出
- 1：拦截
parameters.name: is_defend

parameters.help_en: The title of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 告警标题
parameters.name: alert_title

parameters.help_en: The type of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 告警类型
parameters.name: alert_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 告警名称
parameters.name: alert_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the asset
parameters.help_zh: 资产名称
parameters.name: asset_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset
parameters.help_zh: 资产id
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the entity
parameters.help_zh: 实体名称
parameters.name: entity_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the entity
parameters.help_zh: 实体id
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is associated with the alert
parameters.help_zh: 告警实际关联阿里账号ID
parameters.name: sub_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The alert type. Valid values:

- `system`: An alert generated from aggregated analysis

- `custom`: An alert generated from custom analysis

- `cfw`: firewall

- `waf`: web application firewall

- `edr`: endpoint detection and response

- `other`: other
parameters.help_zh:
告警查询类型。

- system：聚合分析告警
- custom：自定义分析告警
- cfw：防火墙
- waf：Web应用防火墙
- edr：端点检测与响应
- other：其他
parameters.name: label_type

parameters.help_en: The status of the alert
parameters.help_zh: 告警状态
parameters.name: alert_status

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间, 单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间, 单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 列表当前页号， 大于等于1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页条数， 最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The view type of the alert. Valid values:

- `0`: current account

- `1`: all accounts
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who is used to switch the account to view the data of the member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. You are required to specify this parameter based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:

- `cn-hangzhou`: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- `ap-southeast-1`: Your assets reside outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
